family.description: This entry includes Tll0287 protein from Thermosynechococcus vestitus ([swissprot:Q8DM36]) and similar bacterial proteins. Tll0287 is a c-type heme protein that shows a beta-sheet with four antiparallel beta-strands surrounded by five alpha-helices. This structure is similar to some kinases and sensor proteins, but its specific function is unknown [[cite:PUB00100684]].
family.name: Tll0287
